name: print-social-wallethub-crypto-promo-with-green-and-red-balance-cards
title: 'All Your Assets in One Powerful WalletHub' promo with glowing green and red balance cards
whatItIs: A portrait black post on a faint grid with a big uppercase headline half white, half mint green, a time-range segmented control (24h, Week, Month) with 'Week' active, and two balance cards: a green-outlined card with a rising area chart and +2.47% tag, and a red-outlined card with a falling chart and -3.47% tag.
whatItMeans: Clear and thrilling; gain and loss colours make portfolio moves instantly readable.
techniques: Pair a green gain card with a red loss card.
Outline cards in neon matching their chart.
Include a segmented control to hint at interactivity.
Split the headline colour at the product name.

vocabulary.definition: A row of toggle buttons choosing one option.
A line chart with the area below filled.
